sections.Highlights: THIS... is a 2012 Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG Roadster, finished in Obsidian Black Metallic with a black soft top and a black interior. The odometer on this Roadster currently displays approximately 15,300 miles. According to the build sheet provided in the gallery, notable factory equipment includes 20-inch AMG wheels, a limited-slip differential, an AMG Ceramic Compound braking system, a power-operated soft top, Designo leather upholstery, an Airscarf neck-level heating system, and a rearview camera. Notable modifications reported by the selling dealer are limited to the removal of the catalytic converters. Released in 2010, the Mercedes-Benz SLS stood out as the first production car developed in-house from the ground up by AMG. It featured a front-mid-mounted engine, an aluminum chassis, and, in coupe form, gullwing doors that echoed the 300 SL built in the 1960s. Production ended after 2015. Power comes from a 6.2-liter V8, rated at 563 horsepower and 479 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission.

sections.Seller Notes: Due to the modifications performed to this Roadster, it may not pass emissions testing in some states. As always, it's the buyer's responsibility to perform all due diligence regarding registering this Roadster in their respective state prior to placing a bid. The tires on this SLS carry 2026 date codes.
